# Movie dataset initial exploration

[link to the description online](https://vincentarelbundock.github.io/Rdatasets/doc/ggplot2movies/movies.html)

The data contains: - 58,788 movies (rows) - 24 columns: - Movie title - Year - Length (minutes) - Budget - Rating - Votes - r1-10 (percentile per score 1-10, rounded to nearest 10%) - MPAA rating - Genre (action, animation, comedy, drama, documentary, romance, short)

```{r initial exploration}
head(movies)
dim(movies)
```

## Visualize data distributions

The distribution of each relevant numerical variable can be visualized in the following density graphs. These are: year, length, budget, rating, and number of votes.

```{r}

movies %>% 
  pivot_longer(
  cols = 2:6,   
  names_to = "variable",      
  values_to = "value"         
) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = value, fill = variable, colour = variable)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ variable, 
    scales = "free",
  labeller = as_labeller(c(
    "year" = "Year",
    "length"= "Length",
    "budget"= "Budget",
    "rating"= "Rating",
    "votes"= "Number of votes"))) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```
